a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.title: How to Convert HEIC to JPG on Your Phone and Laptop (Free, No App Needed)
a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.excerpt: Can't open your iPhone's HEIC photos on Windows or Android? Convert HEIC to JPG in seconds, for free and without uploading your photos to a server.
a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.cap0: Taking a photo with a smartphone camera.
a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.body:
iPhones save photos in HEIC format because the files are smaller than JPG at the same quality. The catch is that many devices and apps, especially older versions of Windows, Android, and websites, still can't open HEIC. The simplest fix is to convert HEIC to JPG.

With I Need Convert, you can do it right in your browser. Your photos are never uploaded to any server, so they stay private.

What Is HEIC?

HEIC (High Efficiency Image Container) is a modern image format that Apple has used since iOS 11. It can store photos at about half the size of a JPG, and it supports Live Photos and richer color depth. Unfortunately, support for it is still patchy.

How to Convert HEIC to JPG

  1. Open ineedconvert.com in the browser on your phone or laptop.
  2. Tap Choose File, then select one or several HEIC photos at once.
  3. For each file, choose JPG from the dropdown.
  4. Tap Convert or Convert all.
  5. Your JPG photos download to your device automatically.

Tip: Need a transparent background? Choose PNG. Want the smallest possible file to send in a chat? Choose WEBP.

Make Your iPhone Save JPG Directly

If you'd rather have your iPhone shoot in JPG from the start, go to Settings → Camera → Formats and choose Most Compatible. Your next photos will be saved as JPG, but the files will be a bit larger.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does the photo quality get worse?

The difference is almost impossible to see. JPGs are saved at 92% quality, which is high enough for printing and for posting on social media.

Can I convert lots of photos at once?

Yes. Select or drag all your photos into the converter box, then tap Convert all.
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.title: How to Turn a Video into an MP3 Without Any App
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.excerpt: Pull the audio out of an MP4, MOV, or MKV video and save it as a 192 kbps MP3. Free, fast, and right in your browser.
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.body:
Sometimes all you need is the sound: a recorded lecture, a video podcast, a music practice session, or a meeting recording. Instead of installing another app, you can turn a video into an MP3 right in I Need Convert.

The Steps

  1. Open the converter page and tap Choose File.
  2. Select a video (MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, AVI, and more).
  3. In the format dropdown, choose MP3.
  4. Tap Convert and wait for the progress bar to finish.
  5. The MP3 file is saved straight to your Downloads folder.

The first time you convert a video or audio file, your browser needs to load the conversion engine, which is about 30 MB. After that, later conversions are much faster.

Choose the Right Audio Format

  • MP3: the most compatible option, plays on any device.
  • M4A / AAC: small files with good quality, great for iPhone. From an MP4 video, the audio can be copied without re-encoding, so it's almost instant.
  • WAV / FLAC: no quality-damaging compression, ideal for editing.
  • OPUS / OGG: very efficient for speech.

Tip: For a voice recording you plan to edit, save it as WAV first, then convert it to MP3 once you're done editing.

Use It Responsibly

Make sure you have the rights to the video you're converting. For content that belongs to someone else, use it for personal purposes only and respect the creator's copyright.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.title: How to Convert PDF to Word (DOCX) for Free and Safely
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.excerpt: Turn the text in a PDF into an editable Word document. No sign-up, no watermark, and your file is never uploaded to a server.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.cap0: Typing a document on a laptop.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.cap1: A notebook and pen on a desk.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.body:
PDFs are great for reading and sharing, but they're hard to edit. If you need to pull out the contents of a PDF and rework them, the fastest way is to convert the PDF to Word (DOCX).

How to Convert PDF to DOCX

  1. Open I Need Convert and select your PDF file.
  2. Choose the DOCX format.
  3. Tap Convert, then open the result in Microsoft Word, Google Docs, or WPS.

The text from each page is extracted and rebuilt as paragraphs you can edit right away.

Good to Know

  • Scanned PDFs contain images, not text. For these, the text can't be extracted without OCR.
  • Complex layouts such as multiple columns, tables, and images don't always carry over. This conversion focuses on the text content.
  • If all you need is the raw text, choose the TXT format.

Tip: Want to keep the PDF looking exactly like the original? Convert the PDF to PNG or JPG, one image per page. You'll find a guide in our article on how to turn a PDF into images.

Why Is It Safer?

Documents like contracts, payslips, or ID cards shouldn't be uploaded to just any website. With I Need Convert, everything happens on your own device, so your documents never leave your phone or laptop.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.title: How to Turn a PDF into JPG or PNG Images
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.excerpt: Every PDF page becomes one sharp image. Download them one by one or all at once in a single ZIP file.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.cap1: Opening a document on a laptop.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.body:
Sending a PDF through chat can be a hassle because the recipient has to open another app. Turning a PDF into images lets people view the content right away, share it as a status, or paste it into a presentation.

The Steps

  1. Open I Need Convert and select your PDF file.
  2. Choose the JPG, PNG, or WEBP format.
  3. Tap Convert.
  4. Download each page, or tap Download all to save every page in one ZIP.

Pages are rendered at double resolution, so text stays sharp when you zoom in.

JPG, PNG, or WEBP?

  • JPG: small files, good for documents with pictures or for sending in chats.
  • PNG: the sharpest for text and graphics, but with larger files.
  • WEBP: the best compromise between sharpness and size.

Still not sure? Read about the differences between JPG, PNG, and WEBP.
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.title: JPG vs PNG vs WEBP: Choosing the Right Image Format
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.excerpt: When should you use JPG, PNG, or WEBP? Learn the pros and cons of each so your images stay sharp and lightweight.
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.cap1: A graphic designer working at a computer.
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.body:
The right image format can make a file much smaller without looking any different. Here's how the three most popular formats compare.

JPG

JPG uses lossy compression, meaning some detail is thrown away to keep the file small. It's great for photos, but not so good for text, logos, or screenshots, because the edges can look blurry. JPG doesn't support transparent backgrounds.

PNG

PNG uses lossless compression, so no detail is lost. It's the best choice for screenshots, logos, icons, and images with transparent backgrounds. The downside is that photos saved as PNG can be very large.

WEBP

WEBP is a modern format from Google that supports both lossy and lossless compression, plus transparency. It's usually 25–35% smaller than JPG at equivalent quality. It's a great fit for websites and for sending in chats.

Summary

  • Photos for printing or sending: JPG.
  • Logos, icons, screenshots: PNG.
  • Images for websites: WEBP.
  • Website icons (favicons): ICO.

Tip: You can convert between all of these formats in I Need Convert, including from HEIC, BMP, TIFF, and SVG.
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.title: How to Convert MOV to MP4 Without Losing Quality
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.excerpt: MOV videos from your iPhone or camera won't play on every device? Convert them to MP4 in seconds without re-encoding.
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.cap1: A smartphone camera and a digital camera.
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.body:
MOV is the default video format on iPhones and many cameras. Unfortunately, some apps, TVs, and websites don't support it. MP4 is the safest format because it plays almost anywhere.

How to Convert MOV to MP4

  1. Open I Need Convert and select your MOV video.
  2. Choose the MP4 format.
  3. Tap Convert and wait until it's done.

Why Is It So Fast?

MOV and MP4 are really just "containers". What's inside, the H.264/HEVC video and AAC audio, is usually the same. I Need Convert first tries to move the video stream into the new container without re-encoding. The result is almost instant and the quality is 100% identical to the original.

If the video's contents don't fit the target container, the video is automatically re-encoded with H.264 so it still plays.

Tip: The same approach works for MKV to MP4, MP4 to MOV, and TS to MP4.

Other Video Formats

  • WEBM: great for websites.
  • MKV: supports lots of subtitles and audio tracks.
  • GIF: for short animations without sound. See how to make a GIF from a video.
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.title: How to Convert Excel (XLSX) to CSV, JSON, and Back Again
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.excerpt: Turn an Excel file into CSV to import into other apps, or CSV into XLSX so it opens neatly in Excel. All sheets are converted too.
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.cap0: Charts and data on a desk.
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.body:
Many apps, from online stores to accounting software, ask for data in CSV format. On the flip side, CSV files are easier to work with when converted to XLSX. You can do both in I Need Convert.

Excel to CSV

  1. Select an XLSX, XLS, or ODS file.
  2. Choose the CSV format.
  3. Tap Convert. If the file has several sheets, each sheet becomes its own CSV file, and you can download them all as a ZIP.

CSV files are saved with a UTF-8 BOM, so characters like é or ü display correctly when opened in Excel.

CSV to Excel

Select a CSV or TSV file, then choose XLSX, XLS, or ODS.

Spreadsheet to JSON

For developers, choose the JSON format. Each row becomes an object with the column names as keys. And the other way around, JSON, YAML, or XML files can also be converted to CSV or XLSX.

Tip: Excel formulas don't carry over to CSV, only the calculated values do. Keep the original XLSX file too if you still need the formulas.
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.title: How to Make a GIF from a Video Easily
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.excerpt: Turn a clip from a video into an animated GIF that loops. Lightweight, with good colors, right in your browser.
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.body:
GIFs are still the easiest way to share a short animation: a funny reaction, a tutorial step, or an app demo. You can make a GIF from a video in MP4, MOV, WEBM, and more.

The Steps

  1. Get a short video ready, ideally under 10 seconds.
  2. Open I Need Convert and select the video.
  3. Choose the GIF format, then tap Convert.

The GIF is created at 12 frames per second, with a maximum width of 480 pixels and a color palette calculated specifically from your video. The result stays sharp at a reasonable file size.

Tips to Keep Your GIF Light

  • Use a short video. Duration has the biggest effect on file size.
  • Avoid videos with a lot of camera movement.
  • If the GIF is still too big, consider WEBM or MP4 instead. They can be 10 times smaller and still autoplay on many platforms.

GIF to Video

It works the other way too: a GIF can be converted to MP4 or WEBM. This is handy for uploading to platforms that don't accept GIFs.
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.title: Is Converting Files Online Safe? What You Need to Know
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.excerp: Many online converters upload your files to their servers. Learn the risks and how to convert important documents safely.
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.body:
Online converters are certainly convenient, but most of them work by uploading your file to a server, processing it there, and sending the result back. That might be fine for vacation photos, but what about your ID card, a work contract, or customer data?

The Risks of Uploading Files

  • Files may stay on the server longer than promised.
  • Servers can be hacked and files leaked.
  • You don't know who has access to your files.
  • Uploading and downloading large files eats up your data and your time.

How Is I Need Convert Different?

I Need Convert runs every conversion inside your browser. Your files are read and processed by your own device, and the result is saved straight to your Downloads folder. No file is ever sent to our servers.

As a bonus, since there's no upload step, image and document conversions can finish in just seconds.

Tips for Converting Documents Safely

  • Use a converter that processes files locally for sensitive documents.
  • Delete converted files from your Downloads folder when you no longer need them.
  • Avoid converting important documents on public computers.
a.file-hasil-convert-tidak-bisa-dibuka.t: Converted File Won't Open? Causes and Fixes
a.file-hasil-convert-tidak-bisa-dibuka.e: Your converted file won't open or play? Here are the most common causes and how to fix them.
a.file-hasil-convert-tidak-bisa-dibuka.c: Confused because a file won't open.
a.file-hasil-convert-tidak-bisa-dibuka.b:
Once in a while, a converted file won't open in a particular app. Usually the file isn't corrupted; the app simply doesn't support that format. Here are the most common cases.

1. The App Doesn't Support the Format

Formats like WEBP, AVIF, OPUS, or MKV aren't supported by every older app. The fix is to pick a more common format: JPG for images, MP3 for audio, and MP4 for video.

2. Video Converted Without Re-encoding

When you change a video's container, for example MKV to MP4, the video stream is copied as is. If the original video uses the HEVC (H.265) codec, some older devices can't play it. Try converting to WEBM or AVI, which are always re-encoded, or play it with VLC.

3. The File Hasn't Finished Downloading

For large files, wait until the download in your browser has fully finished before opening it.

4. Empty Text When Converting a PDF to DOCX or TXT

The PDF is most likely a scan, so its contents are images. Convert it to JPG or PNG to keep the contents.

5. Strange Characters in a CSV

Make sure you open the CSV with UTF-8 encoding. CSV files from I Need Convert already include a UTF-8 marker so Excel reads them correctly.

Still having trouble? Also read about the differences between JPG, PNG, and WEBP to choose the best format.
